name: Bazaar
tagline: Multi-vendor commerce platform: storefront, vendor portal, admin console, split orders, double-entry ledger and tracking.
description:
A complete multi-vendor commerce product for artisan, handloom, and direct-to-consumer brands, built as three apps on one TypeScript API and one PostgreSQL database.

Shoppers browse curated collections, filter by category and artisan shop, add products from multiple vendors into a single cart, checkout with upfront delivery fees and coupons, track independent per-vendor shipments in real time, and leave verified reviews. Vendors manage their storefront profile and bank accounts, list products with multi-variant matrices (SKU, size, color, inventory), fulfill orders through an auditable 5-step shipping state machine, generate shipping labels and courier tracking, and receive automated payout settlements. The operations team supervises the marketplace: vendor KYC verification and onboarding, global order tracking, commission rules per shop, financial double-entry ledger audits, and payout approvals.

Everything runs offline and without paid credentials: payments and courier logistics are simulated mocks behind clean platform provider interfaces, and comprehensive deterministic seed fixtures populate over 20 shops, 50+ products, and dozens of orders and ledger entries out of the box. Sign in with the demo logins below, or customize via chat.

roles.name: Shopper
roles.description: Explores shops, buys multi-vendor carts, tracks shipments, and writes reviews.

roles.name: Vendor
roles.description: Manages catalog, inventory, packs and ships orders, and tracks payout settlements.

roles.name: Marketplace Admin
roles.description: Supervises marketplace: KYC verification, orders, commissions, ledger, and payouts.

features: Multi-vendor shared shopping cart with automatic per-vendor split order fulfillment
Variant matrix with dynamic SKU, color, size, and real-time inventory reservation
5-stage shipment state machine (placed -> accepted -> packed -> shipped -> delivered)
Real-time courier dispatch and checkpoint tracking over Server-Sent Events
Double-entry multi-party accounting ledger with platform commission withholding
Automated vendor payout settlement batches with direct bank transfer reconciliation
Verified purchase buyer reviews with rating score aggregation
Percentage and flat promotional coupons with order caps and expiry rules
Vendor KYC onboarding and store verification workflow
Platform operator audit log tracking administrative overrides and status transitions
